aboutSubheading: Quality carpentry built on experience and integrity
aboutText: Andrews All Round Carpentry brings over 18 years of hands-on experience to homes and businesses throughout Victoria. From custom decks and pergolas to full kitchen and bathroom renovations, our dedicated team delivers quality workmanship on every project we take on. Based in Melbourne, we service all surrounding suburbs and regional areas with the same commitment to excellence and attention to detail.
fullWidthImageAlt: Beautiful finished home interior with quality carpentry
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive carpentry solutions for every part of your home
servicesText: From small repairs to major renovations, Andrews All Round Carpentry covers the full spectrum of residential and commercial carpentry services across Victoria.

services.title: General Carpentry
services.desc: From framing and structural work to custom shelving, built-in wardrobes, and timber repairs — no job is too big or small for our experienced team.

services.title: Decks & Pergolas
services.desc: Custom-designed outdoor living spaces built to last. We work with Merbau, Spotted Gum, treated pine, and composite materials to create your perfect entertaining area.

services.title: Glass Pool & Spa Fencing
services.desc: Fully compliant frameless and semi-frameless glass fencing solutions that keep your family safe while maintaining uninterrupted views of your pool or garden.

services.title: Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete bathroom transformations from strip-out to final fit-off. We handle all carpentry, framing, and installation to bring your dream bathroom to life.

services.title: Kitchen Renovations
services.desc: Custom cabinetry, island benches, pantry builds, and full kitchen fit-outs designed around your lifestyle. Quality joinery that makes your kitchen the heart of the home.

services.title: Flooring
services.desc: Expert installation of solid timber, engineered, laminate, and hybrid flooring. We'll help you choose the right product and ensure a flawless finish every time.

testimonialsSubheading: Don't just take our word for it — hear from the homeowners we've helped

testimonials.text: Andrew and the boys built us a stunning Merbau deck out the back and we absolutely love it. The quality of work is outstanding, they kept the site clean, and finished ahead of schedule. Already planning to get them back for the pergola next year!

testimonials.text: We had our entire kitchen renovated and the attention to detail was second to none. Andrew was upfront about costs and timelines right from the start, and his communication throughout the project was excellent. Couldn't recommend them highly enough.
testimonials.name: Sarah Crawford

testimonials.text: Fantastic job on our bathroom reno. We'd had a bad experience with another tradie before, so we were cautious, but Andrew put us at ease straight away. The result is exactly what we envisioned — professional, tidy, and fairly priced. Will definitely use again.
testimonials.name: Tom Bellingham
